movies.title: Inception
movies.synopsis: A thief who steals corporate secrets through the use of dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a C.E.O., but his tragic past may doom the project and his team to disaster.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.synopsis: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.synopsis: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

movies.title: Pulp Fiction
movies.synopsis: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption in Los Angeles.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.synopsis: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.synopsis: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.synopsis: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during the Manhattan Project.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.synopsis: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence. When heroes clash on how to handle a threat, Miles must redefine what it means to be a hero.

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.synopsis: When a beautiful stranger leads computer hacker Neo to a forbidding underworld, he discovers the shocking truth--the life he knows is the elaborate deception of an evil cyber-intelligence.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.synopsis: A writer encounters the owner of an aging high-class hotel, who tells him of his early years serving as a lobby boy in the hotel's glorious years under an exceptional concierge.

movies.title: Se7en
movies.synopsis: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
movies.synopsis: A middle-aged Chinese immigrant is swept up into an insane adventure in which she alone can save existence by exploring other universes and connecting with the lives she could have led.

genres.name: Sci-Fi
genres.description: Science fiction speculative fiction exploring futuristic concepts, space exploration, and time travel.

genres.name: Action
genres.description: Fast-paced cinema featuring high-energy stunts, choreography, chases, and dramatic conflicts.

genres.name: Drama
genres.description: Narrative fiction focusing on realistic characters facing deep emotional struggles and moral dilemmas.

genres.name: Crime
genres.description: Stories centering around illegal masterminds, detectives, heists, and the justice system.

genres.name: Comedy
genres.description: Lighthearted entertainment designed to amuse, provoke laughter, and spotlight whimsical ironies.

genres.name: Animation
genres.description: Artful visual storytelling using computer-generated or hand-drawn sequences for all audiences.

genres.name: Thriller
genres.description: Suspenseful, tension-building narratives with unexpected plot twists and psychological intrigue.

genres.name: Adventure
genres.description: Epic journeys, exploration of exotic locales, and courageous quests through perilous horizons.

reviews.comment: An extraordinary cinematic tour de force. Nolan's multi-layered dream logic keeps you on the edge of your seat until the spinning top wobbles.
Hans Zimmer's soundtrack elevates every scene. The zero-gravity hallway fight remains one of the best stunts ever choreographed.
Heath Ledger gives a defining performance of our generation. Gritty, intense, and philosophically profound superhero cinema.
Emotionally devastating and scientifically awe-inspiring. The depiction of relativistic time dilation on Miller's planet is unforgettable.
Denis Villeneuve cemented his place as the sci-fi visionary of our era. The sandworm riding sequence gave me literal chills.
Cillian Murphy conveys immense inner turmoil with just his eyes. The Trinity test sequence was masterfully quiet before the shockwave.
Every single frame is worthy of being framed in a modern art gallery. The blend of art styles and emotional depth is unparalleled.
Chaotic, profound, funny, and deeply touching. It turned a pair of rocks with googly eyes into one of the most emotional scenes in film.
